newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer-Standard, U.S. Robotics in pact.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer-Standard, U.S. Robotics in pact.

text.p: Pioneer-Standard Electronics Inc on Monday said it agreed to distribute U.S. Robotics Corp's end-to-end line of remote access products, enterprise communications systems, desktop/mobile client products and modems.
Many of these products feature U.S. Robotics x2 technology, which downloads online information nearly twice as fast as standard V.34 modems, the company said.

"This strategic partnership significantly enhances Pioneer's networking and remote access strategy and offers our customers advanced x2 technology connectivity," said Robert Bailey, a vice president at Pioneer-Standard.
Pioneer-Standard, a distributor of computer products and industrial electronic components, did not disclose further details of the agreement.
